    from astropy.units import Quantity
    if not quantities:
        raise ValueError('No quantities provided for validation.')
    first_unit = quantities[0].unit

            raise ValueError(f'Units {q.unit} and {first_unit} are not equivalent.')

def apply_change_to_nodes(self, nodes, text, pos):
    try:
        nodes.remove(None)
    except:
        pass
    sorted_nodes = sorted(nodes, key=lambda node: node.priority)
    for node in sorted_nodes:
        result = self.change_node(node, text, pos)
        if result:
            return
    if sorted_nodes:
        current_node = sorted_nodes[0]
        node_text = current_node.text if hasattr(current_node, 'text') else ''
        if node_text and 0 < pos < len(node_text):
            left_text = node_text[:pos]
            right_text = node_text[pos:]
            current_node.text = left_text
            current_node.regex = self.getPL().regex(left_text)
            current_node.priority = self.getPL().priority(left_text)
            current_node.lookup = self.getPL().name(left_text)
            new_node = TextNode(Terminal(right_text), -1, [], pos)
            new_node.regex = self.getPL().regex(right_text)
            new_node.priority = self.getPL().priority(right_text)
            new_node.lookup = self.getPL().name(right_text)
            current_node.parent.insert_after_node(current_node, new_node)
            return
    new_node = TextNode(Terminal(text), -1, [], pos)
    new_node.regex = self.getPL().regex(text)
    new_node.priority = self.getPL().priority(text)
    new_node.lookup = self.getPL().name(text)
    if sorted_nodes:
        sorted_nodes[0].parent.insert_after_node(sorted_nodes[0], new_node)

import os
import mmap
from zlib import crc32

def recover_segment(self, segment, filename):
    if segment in self.fds:
        del self.fds[segment]
    with open(filename, 'rb') as fd:
        with mmap.mmap(fd.fileno(), 0, access=mmap.ACCESS_READ) as mm:
            data = memoryview(mm)
            os.rename(filename, filename + '.beforerecover')
            logger.info('attempting to recover ' + filename)
            with open(filename, 'wb') as fd_out:
                fd_out.write(MAGIC)
                while len(data) >= self.header_fmt.size:
                    (crc, size, tag) = self.header_fmt.unpack(data[:self.header_fmt.size])
                    if size < self.header_fmt.size or size > len(data):
                        data = data[1:]
                        continue
                    if crc32(data[4:size]) & 4294967295 != crc:
                        data = data[1:]
                        continue
                    fd_out.write(data[:size])
                    data = data[size:]

    index = argv
    x = inputs[0]
    y = inputs[1]
    p = inputs[2]

    dx = 3 * x - x ** 3 + 2 - y + self._stimulus[index] * potential_influence + self._coupling_term[index] - self._noise[index]
    dy = self._params.eps * (self._params.gamma * (1 + math.tanh(x / self._params.betta)) - y)

    for index_neighbor in neighbors:

    dp = self._params.lamda * (1 - p) * heaviside(potential - self._params.teta_p) - self._params.mu * p
    coupling = 0

    where_conditions = []

    where_conditions.append(and_(Pokestop.latitude >= min_lat, Pokestop.longitude >= min_lon, Pokestop.latitude <= max_lat, Pokestop.longitude <= max_lon))

def pretty_list(rtlst, header, sortBy=0):
    _l_header = len(header[0])
    _space = '  '
    rtlst.sort(key=lambda x: x[sortBy])
    rtlst = header + rtlst
    colwidth = [max((len(str(y)) for y in x)) for x in zip(*rtlst)]
    width = get_terminal_width()
    if width:
        total_width = sum(colwidth) + 6
        if total_width > width:
            _med = width // _l_header - (1 if WINDOWS else 0)
            while total_width > width:
                _max = max(colwidth)
                colwidth = [_med if x == _max else x for x in colwidth]
                total_width = sum(colwidth) + 6

            def _crop(x, width):
                if len(x) > width:
                    return x[:width - 3] + '...'
                return x
            rtlst = [tuple((_crop(rtlst[j][i], colwidth[i]) for i in range(len(rtlst[j])))) for j in range(len(rtlst))]
            colwidth = [max((len(str(y)) for y in x)) for x in zip(*rtlst)]
    fmt = _space.join(['%%-%ds' % x for x in colwidth])
    rt = '\n'.join([fmt % x for x in rtlst])
    return rt
